The SEC Newgate team operates seamlessly in 22 countries across five continents, helping clients clearly demonstrate their purpose and value, delivering around the clock counsel and support, implementing campaigns locally, nationally and internationally. Clients span finance and financial services, health sciences and wellbeing, manufacturing and industry, TMT, real estate and infrastructure and consumer sectors.

Founded in 1983 by the Shearer family, Shearer Supply is a leading replacement-focused HVAC distribution platform of scale providing residential and commercial equipment, parts and supplies to a highly fragmented base of 5,500+ local contractor customers in the Southern U.S. region. The Company serves customers from over 30 branches across Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Tennessee, Mississippi, Louisiana and New Mexico. Headquartered in Dallas, TX, Shearer’s core product lines include American Standard Residential and Commercial HVAC, Ameristar Heating and Air Conditioning and Samsung HVAC. The Company also offers parts, supplies and accessories sourced from over 300 vendors.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London, Smart is a specialist provider of critical M&E maintenance services, including HVAC, electrical, fire, water and gas systems. The Company focuses on high-quality commercial office buildings and technical end-markets such as life sciences, education, digital infrastructure and public sector assets. Smart has built a differentiated reputation through consistently high service quality, data-led delivery model and strong relationships with blue-chip managing agents and direct clients. The business has delivered strong performance in recent years, driven by increasing demand for high quality, reliable, mission-critical facilities management services in a large, resilient and highly fragmented market.

Based in the Netherlands, SPGPrints is a leading global manufacturer of consumables for printed textiles and labels. The product offering primarily consists of consumables used in the printing process (rotary screens, lacquers, digital inks and digital engraving) complemented by a full range of printing systems/equipment and after-sales spare parts, installation and maintenance services. SPGPrints is represented in more than 100 countries worldwide and commands a leading market position in each of its segments.

Established in 1982, Stowe is a fast-growing, tech-enabled family law firm operating across England & Wales, Scotland and Australia. Headquartered in Leeds, Stowe has more than 90 offices and over 200 family lawyers supporting more than 5,000 clients each year. Stowe has built a differentiated and scalable business model combining digitally-led client acquisition, with the vast majority of new enquiries generated online, and a centralized corporate platform supporting its lawyers. This model has enabled Stowe to become the largest family law firm in the UK and establish a growing international presence. Under Investcorp’s ownership, Stowe has continued to invest in technology, data and AI to enhance the client experience, improve operational efficiency and support the continued growth of the business.

Sunrise Produce is recognized as a leading wholesale produce distribution company in Southern California, providing customers across the specialty and white tablecloth restaurant and resort, education, healthcare and retail sectors with the freshest produce and perishable foods available.

TPx Communications (formerly TelePacific) is a provider of network and communications services headquartered in Los Angeles. In business since 1998, the company is the nation’s premier managed services provider, delivering unified communications, managed IT and network connectivity to 55,000 customer locations across the country.

Established in 2016, TruKKer is the largest digital truck freight aggregator in the MENA region which connects shippers and carriers via a proprietary cloud-based platform. The company leverages technology and AI driven processes to optimize the supply chain and offers its transporters greater utilization by increasing reverse loads and reducing idle time between loads. The company operates in a highly fragmented road freight market across seven countries including Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, Turkey, and Kazakhstan representing a total addressable market of over $50 billion. TruKKer is the largest player in the MENA region with over 1,200 B2B enterprise clients including blue chip customers across the FMGG, retail, metals, petrochemicals and construction sectors and has an expansive carrier network of over 70,000 trucks inducted on its platform leveraging it’s on the ground infrastructure of stations spread across the network. TruKKer continuously invests in innovation with the view to increase economics for all stakeholders of the logistics ecosystem and contribute to the region’s sustainability goals.
hq_location: Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates

description: Ubisense is an enterprise software and sensor platform that generates and interprets vast amounts of location data to create digital visibility of real-world objects and their interactions in real time, enabling complex manufacturing processes with high levels of variability to be more flexible, easier to manage and easier to control. Ubisense’s service solution generates meaningful and demonstrable return on investment to Ubisense’s blue-chip customers. Ubisense is present in a number of verticals, including Aerospace, Commercial Vehicles, Passenger Vehicles, General Industry, and Transportation among many others.

Headquartered in North Carolina, US, Unifyr (formerly Zift Solutions) is a leader in Partner Management Software. Their cloud-based platform unifies partner relationship management (PRM), partner marketing automation (PMA), learning management (LMS), channel operations, and generative AI-driven productivity in one system designed to scale. With nearly two decades of category experience, Unifyr has powered millions of partner leads and generated billions in cumulative channel ecosystem revenue. The platform gives companies a unified view of the entire partner funnel and the intelligence to drive revenue through predictable, scalable channel growth.

Unilog is a global technology company that delivers powerful, affordable e-Commerce solutions and product data enrichment services for the B2B marketplaces in US. Unilog’s cloud-based commerce platform help distributors, manufacturers, and wholesalers increase online sales, reduce cost to serve, and enhance their digital footprint. It is headquartered in greater Philadelphia, Pennsylvania and has international headquarters in Bangalore, India with a team of ~800 employees globally. Unilog currently provides software solution services to more than 320 small and medium enterprises across the distribution & retail businesses operating in the US.

Established in 2010, V-Ensure is a regulated market focused, fully integrated specialty pharma company with more than a decade of experience in development of complex generics formulations. It has proprietary technology platforms and an established R&D track record with successful delivery of over 150 formulations including multiple 505 (b)(2), FTF and FTM opportunities. It has a fully equipped formulation & API R&D center and USFDA approved analytical lab supported by a recently set-up USFDA and EMA approvable oral solids manufacturing facility. V-Ensure is now working towards developing and launching its own products in regulated markets.

Headquartered near Aachen, VEDA is a leading developer of full-suite HR software. The company provides software for payroll, time & security and people management as well as payroll-as-a-service to enterprise customers in the mid-market in Germany.

Established in 1999, Vivaticket S.p.A. is a leading global provider of integrated ticketing software solutions to the leisure and entertainment, sport, culture and trade show industries. With twenty years of experience in the field and relying on the most innovative technological solutions, Vivaticket offers a wide range of services to support events, including through its unique turn-key offering, which addresses the full customer experience from ticket purchasing to on-site activities. Headquartered in Bologna, Italy, Vivaticket has an extensive global presence with over 2,200 clients spanning 50 countries, including some of the world’s leading brands such as Musée du Louvre and FC Barcelona, among others.

Established in 1988, Viz Branz is a leading, family-owned manufacturer and distributor of market leading instant cereal and beverage brands across China and Southeast Asia, including the popular Gold Roast, Calsome, Royal Myanmar Tea and Cafe 21 brands. Headquartered in Singapore, Viz Branz has approximately 1,300 employees with manufacturing facilities and operations in China and Myanmar.

Founded in 2015 by Ankit Garg and Chaitanya Ramalingegowda with the mission to enhance sleep health and overall well-being, Wakefit is India’s #1 direct-to-consumer sleep and home solutions brand. Wakefit’s product portfolio includes mattresses, pillows, beds, sofas, and other home furnishings, all designed with a focus on comfort and support. Started via e-commerce, it has built an omni-channel presence with 80+ stores across 30+ cities in India. The company emphasizes innovation and in-house manufacturing to maintain high standards of quality and affordability.
A leading European special situations and distressed-for-control firm founded in 2010.

WeDoctor is an online healthcare services company founded in 2010 by artificial intelligence expert Jerry Liao. The company has more than 240 million registered users for its online doctors consultation, prescription and diagnosis services. The company builds, owns and operates one of China’s largest digital healthcare infrastructure platforms by linking hospitals and doctors with patients, pharmacies, insurance programs and financial services.

Founded by Anju and Arjun Srivastava, Wingreens is a niche brand in packaged foods with a health positioning. Having started with fresh dips, it diversified into sauces, spreads and an assortment of organic products. It also acquired Raw Pressery, adding healthy beverages to its product portfolio. Wingreens’ network reach spans India across retail format: modern and traditional channels, as well as eCommerce. They have a deep commitment to sustainability and empower women through their Women’s Initiative Network.

Founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneurs Amitava Saha and Supam Maheshwari, Xpressbees is amongst the leading technology-led express logistics service provider in India. Along with its market leading p​resence in e-commerce logistics, Xpressbees is in the process of transforming itself into a technology driven supply chain company with presence across Express Cargo, 3PL and Cross Border logistics

Founded in 1870, Zacco is a leading full-service Intellectual Property (IP) provider, offering end-to-end solutions across the entire IP lifecycle. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Zacco has a strong footprint in the Nordics, Germany, the UK, India, and the US, with over 450 professionals serving 4,000+ clients worldwide. Leveraging its proprietary technology platform, IPView, Zacco provides comprehensive IP services and solutions – from initial patent and trademark filings to ongoing portfolio management, IP asset renewal, online security, and brand protection. Zacco combines a people-first and technology-led approach, with an end-to-end delivery model that provides a “one-stop shop” to its customers, enabling them to safeguard their intangible assets in an increasingly digital world. With a strong market presence and deep industry expertise, Zacco continues to be a trusted partner for multinational corporations and mid-sized enterprises looking to protect and manage their intellectual property. Zacco and its team of IP experts have repeatedly earned top-tier rankings and recommendations from industry bodies such as World Trademark Review, Intellectual Asset Management, Managing IP, and Legal 500.

ZoloStays (Zolo) provides convenient full-stack co-living services to young professionals and students in India who are looking for long-duration stays across budget-friendly or premium pricepoints. Zolo is disrupting the traditional paying-guest (PG) market in India by providing professional facility management services, catering and utilities through a plug-and-play model in carefully-curated living spaces. With headquarters in Bangalore, Zolo provides co-living solutions in ten Indian cities. Zolo was founded in 2015 by three individuals:Dr Nikhil Sikri, Sneha Chaudhury and Akhil Sikri.
